text:
Software is complicated by nature. It's our job to make it easy for the user.

Take a look at FFmpeg as an example. It's a complex tool that can do most things audio/video. A power user can do magical things, but they still provide simple commands for the most basic use-cases like conversion or trimming.

https://www.clipcat.com/blog/how-to-use-ffmpeg-a-beginners-g...

1. Provide sensible defaults 2. Study user journeys and write simple manuals for them. 3. Ask friends or internet communities for feedback.

Don't get discouraged, you can do it!
